title: Fallback grey 0xFF888888 hardcoded
description: C substrate invents a visible grey color when no fill is set. Violates "all visual values through vtable". Should be transparent (0x00000000) so Kain code owns the default.
notable: One-line fix: change `fill_color = 0xFF888888` to `continue` (skip unsized items)

title: 20KB stack arrays (5x1024 ints)
description: 5 stack arrays of 1024 ints each = ~20KB on C stack. Risk of overflow on embedded/WASM targets. MAX_CHILDREN=1024 also duplicates KAINTANA_MAX_CHILDREN from internal.h.
notable: Replace with arena allocation or dynamic sizing

title: 24 hardcoded theme colors in named table
description: color.c lines 78-91 contain 24 theme color values (0xFF1A1A2E, 0xFF0F3460, etc.) that are exactly what killed KUIF — visual defaults baked into C. Keep only CSS web colors.
notable: Remove entries "bg" through "border"; keep only CSS web colors (red/green/blue/black/white/transparent/gray)

title: node_capacity uses 2048 instead of KAINTANA_MAX_NODES (4096)
description: tree.c:127 hardcodes 2048 while internal.h defines KAINTANA_MAX_NODES=4096. Two diverging limits causes confusion when internal.h changes.

title: layout_capacity uses 2048 instead of KAINTANA_MAX_NODES (4096)
description: tree.c:139 same divergence as node_capacity. Layout capacity should track node capacity.

title: 0xFF000000 fallback on parse failure (6 sites)
description: color.c returns solid black 0xFF000000 when hex parsing fails. Should return 0 (transparent) or an error sentinel so Kain code detects the failure.

title: flex_basis sentinel uses 0.0f instead of UNDEFINED
description: box_math.c:22 uses `l->flex_basis != 0.0f` to mean "auto = use intrinsic size" while rest of file uses IS_UNDEF/UNDEFINED (FLT_MAX*0.5f). Fragile — mixing sentinel strategies creates latent bug path.

title: 1.0e6f clip infinity unnamed
description: draw_pixels.c:1000-1001 uses bare 1.0e6f for "effectively unlimited" initial clip bounds. Unexplained magic number.

title: 128 duplicates KAINTANA_DRAW_BATCH_INIT
description: draw_pixels.c:893 hardcodes 128 for minimum batch capacity. internal.h:48 already defines KAINTANA_DRAW_BATCH_INIT 128.

title: tree.c uses 2048 instead of KAINTANA_MAX_NODES (4096)
description: Same as HL-DATA-004/005 but consolidated. Three hardcoded capacity sites in tree.c use 2048 while internal.h defines 4096.
notable: Consolidate all capacity hardcodes to use KAINTANA_MAX_NODES

title: 256 fixed-point scale unnamed (6+ sites)
description: draw_pixels.c uses bare 256 in 6+ places for 8.8 fixed-point conversions. Should be #define KT_FIXED_POINT_SCALE 256 with documentation.
notable: Create KT_FIXED_POINT_SCALE, use in all 6+ sites

title: Phase count 3 is magic number
description: damage.c:358 uses bare `for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)`. Phase count is architectural constant that should be #define KAINTANA_PHASE_COUNT 3.
notable: Add #define KAINTANA_PHASE_COUNT 3 to internal.h or damage.c

title: sort_dir encoded by array index
description: tree.c:157 uses `(i == 1) ? -1 : 1` for sort direction, depending on array index matching phase enum values. If heaps array is reordered, sort silently breaks.
notable: Create phase→direction data table keyed by kt_Phase enum values

title: heaps[3] magic number
description: tree.c:155 uses bare `3` for heap array size. Should use named constant.

title: Full-rebuild threshold 30% unnamed
description: damage.c:430 uses `> 30` for percentage threshold that triggers full rebuild. Should be named #define with research citation.

title: native_scale clamp limits unnamed
description: tree.c:331-332 uses bare 0.1f and 10.0f for native scale clamping. These relate to but are distinct from KT_ZOOM_MIN/MAX. Should have their own named defines.

title: frame_delta_ms default 16.0 unnamed
description: tree.c:168 hardcodes 16.0ms default (60fps assumption). Should be named define for documentation.

title: 1 pixel minimum size unnamed
description: draw_pixels.c:1083-1084 hardcodes minimum element size of 1px. Should be configurable or at least a named define.

title: p0 pointer ID hardcoded
description: tree.c:687,693,699,705 uses bare string "p0" for pointer identifier. Assumes single-pointer input. Multi-touch/pointer systems need dynamic IDs from backend.
notable: Backend should pass pointer ID; make "p0" the default fallback
